6667.title: Permission selections are not delivered without turn input
6667.rootCauseOneLine: The existing-thread permission picker changes component-local state; Claude permission settings are applied on turn input, with no mode-only delivery path.
6667.proposedFix: Design a server-authorized mode-only action shared by the UI, SDK, and CLI, with explicit provider acknowledgement, pending-approval semantics, and restart handling.
6667.caveats: Repeated real-hook and real-SDK transport probe in two clean trusted checkouts, not a native Claude or macOS desktop end-to-end reproduction. The complete approval loop and per-read prompts remain unverified. No safe simple fix because the missing action crosses permission and command boundaries.
